name: St. Antony's HSS Ground
short: Main open-air stage on the school ground.
directions: Enter through the main gate on Mala Road.
Walk straight along the paved path for ~60 metres.
The main ground opens to your left, past the flag post.
Stage 1 is the elevated open-air stage on the far side of the ground.

name: HS Hall
short: High School main hall — large indoor stage.
directions: Enter through the main gate on Mala Road.
Walk straight and take the covered walkway to the right at the flag post.
Enter the HS Block through its main door.
The Main Hall is the first door on your right.

name: GLPS Mala
short: Stage at the Government Lower Primary School, Mala.
accessibility: Short outdoor path · some uneven ground
directions: Exit St. Antony's HSS through the south gate (opposite the HS Block).
Cross the narrow lane and enter the GLPS Mala compound.
Walk past the flag post — Stage 3 is behind the primary classrooms.

name: HSS A1 B1 Classes
short: Combined classrooms A1 and B1 — Higher Secondary block.
directions: Enter through the main gate on Mala Road.
Walk straight along the paved path to the HSS Block.
Enter the HSS Block through its main door.
Rooms A1 and B1 are on the ground floor, second corridor to the right.

name: HSS Seminar Hall
short: Seminar hall in the HSS block, first floor.
accessibility: Stair access only — assist on request
directions: Enter the HSS Block via the main door.
Take the central staircase to the first floor.
The Seminar Hall is directly opposite the staircase landing.

name: Vyaapaara Bhavan
short: Stage at the Traders' Bhavan near the school.
accessibility: Separate building · ~3 min walk from main gate
directions: Exit the main gate and turn left (north) on Mala Road.
Walk about 200 metres along the road.
Vyaapaara Bhavan is the commercial complex on your right.
Stage 6 is on the ground floor, left side.

name: HSS 1st Floor Class
short: First-floor classroom stage in the HSS block.
accessibility: Stair access only — assist on request
directions: Enter the HSS Block via the main door.
Take the east staircase to the first floor.
Turn left at the corridor — Room 1F-A is at the far end.

name: HS 9E Class
short: Classroom 9E in the High School block.
directions: Enter the HS Block via its main door.
Turn right — Room 9E is the second door on the right.

name: HS Arabic Class
short: Arabic classroom in the High School block.
directions: Enter the HS Block via its main door.
Walk past the Main Hall on your left.
Room Arabic is the last door on the right, at the end of the corridor.
